stage1Metrics.note: Presence recall includes members of risky merges; does not claim independent completeness. 26 harmless editorial subdivisions and one student-deals fragment remain as extra units.

sourceLevelRecovery.note: 28 = frozen 26 plus equivalent $uper and Mother bundle boundaries. Bari merged groups not independently correctly represented. This measures identity/classification recovery, not complete safe facts or restriction coverage.

limitations: 68 parseable extraction outputs; ten unrepaired extraction failures and two rejected source segmentations are unknown, never safety successes.
Frozen source-anchor scorer undercounts equivalent boundaries and misses the Bari supporting-group merge; automated counts remain unchanged.
V2 corpus/source-level one-output metrics differ from V3 per-unit metrics; retain all49 source denominator and43 original reviewed economic propositions for end-to-end recall.
Generic collective location labels without all/selected prefix survive thin domain filter; no frozen code edited after launch.
Constraint gold inherited whole-clause roles and heuristic conversions create overly narrow allowed attributes; every emitted condition reviewed under unchanged composable definitions.
Parent had to author/review annotations before freezing; blind tasks and runtime preparation/generation never interpreted V3 gold; scoring only after both seals.
